_description: Macro events calendar. Bot pauses trading before/during these.
_format: Each event has: name, dates (ISO), pause_hours_before, pause_hours_after
_update: Update this file monthly. Dates from federalreserve.gov and bls.gov

recurring_events.name: FOMC Rate Decision
recurring_events.description: Federal Reserve interest rate announcement. Causes 2-5% crypto swings.

recurring_events.name: US CPI Release
recurring_events.description: Consumer Price Index. Released 8:30 AM ET. Major volatility trigger.

recurring_events.name: US Jobs Report (NFP)
recurring_events.description: Non-Farm Payrolls. First Friday of month, 8:30 AM ET.

recurring_events.name: US PPI Release
recurring_events.description: Producer Price Index. Usually day after CPI.

one_time_events.name: Bitcoin Halving (estimated)
one_time_events.description: Block reward cut in half. Extreme volatility weeks before and after.
